userStories.title: Test AutoCaptionDialog._finish_generation functionality
userStories.description:
## PROVIDED CONTEXT — do NOT explore source files

The function you need to test is provided below. Write the test file directly without reading or searching source files.

**File**: `autocaption_dialog.py`  
**Function**: `AutoCaptionDialog._finish_generation`  
**Size**: 40 lines, complexity 8 (medium)

```python
    def _finish_generation(self, cancelled=False):
        """Finish the generation process and show results."""
        # Re-enable UI
        self.generate_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.cancel_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.close_btn.setEnabled(True)
        self.backend_combo.setEnabled(True)

        # Count results
        success_count = sum(1 for _, _, status in self.results if status == "success")
        skip_count = sum(1 for _, _, status in self.results if status == "skipped")
        error_count = sum(
            1 for _, _, status in self.results if status.startswith("error")
        )

        if cancelled:
            self.progress_label.setText(
                f"Cancelled. {success_count} completed, {len(self.image_paths) - self.current_index} remaining."
            )
        else:
            self.progress_label.setText(
                f"Done! {success_count} generated, {skip_count} skipped, {error_count} errors."
            )

        # Show summary if there were errors
        if error_count > 0:
            errors = [
                f"- {os.path.basename(p)}: {s}"
                for p, _, s in self.results
                if s.startswith("error")
            ]
            error_text = "\n".join(errors[:10])
            if error_count > 10:
                error_text += f"\n... and {error_count - 10} more"

            QMessageBox.warning(
                self,
                "Some Errors Occurred",
                f"{error_count} image(s) failed to generate captions:\n\n{error_text}",
            )
```

1. test_finish_generation_with_successful_results — Create AutoCaptionDialog with mock image paths. Set results with successful captions. Call _finish_generation(). Assert progress_label text contains 'Done! 2 generated, 0 skipped, 0 errors.'
2. test_finish_generation_with_skipped_results — Create AutoCaptionDialog with mock image paths. Set results with skipped captions. Call _finish_generation(). Assert progress_label text contains 'Done! 0 generated, 2 skipped, 0 errors.'
3. test_finish_generation_with_error_results — Create AutoCaptionDialog with mock image paths. Set results with error status. Call _finish_generation(). Assert progress_label text contains 'Done! 0 generated, 0 skipped, 2 errors.'
4. test_finish_generation_with_cancelled_status — Create AutoCaptionDialog with mock image paths. Set results with partial completion. Call _finish_generation(cancelled=True). Assert progress_label text contains 'Cancelled. 1 completed, 1 remaining.'
5. test_finish_generation_re_enables_ui — Create AutoCaptionDialog with mock image paths. Call _finish_generation(). Assert generate_btn, close_btn, and backend_combo are enabled, and cancel_btn is disabled.
6. test_finish_generation_shows_error_message_box — Create AutoCaptionDialog with mock image paths. Set results with error status. Call _finish_generation(). Assert QMessageBox.warning was called with error details.
7. test_finish_generation_truncates_long_error_list — Create AutoCaptionDialog with mock image paths. Set results with many error statuses. Call _finish_generation(). Assert error text is truncated and shows '... and X more'.

Run: source ~/scripts/venv/bin/activate && python -m pytest tests/unit/test_autocaption_dialog_AutoCaptionDialog__finish_generation.py -v
